title: Hitendra Vishnu Thakur v. State of Maharashtra

content.caseIdentity: Hitendra Vishnu Thakur v. State of Maharashtra, (1994) 4 SCC 602
content.holding: Held that every violent act or public disturbance cannot be labeled as terrorism; a terrorist act requires the distinct intention or likelihood to strike terror or destabilize the state, distinct from ordinary criminal violence.
content.relevance: Authoritative benchmark for distinguishing ordinary violence from Section 113 BNS terrorist acts.
